title: Lunch at the Cafe
text:
This is the menu at the cafe. The soup costs five zloty. The pizza costs twelve zloty. The juice costs two zloty.

Tom is hungry. He orders pizza and a glass of juice. He pays at the counter. The waiter says thank you.

questions.text: How much does the pizza cost?

options: Pizza and a glass of juice

questions.text: What kind of place is this?
How does Tom probably feel after his meal?

a flat round food with cheese and tomato on top
a drink made from fruit or vegetables
a long table where you pay or order in a shop or cafe

paragraph_translations: To jest menu w kawiarni. Zupa kosztuje pięć złotych. Pizza kosztuje dwanaście złotych. Sok kosztuje dwa złote.
Tomek jest głodny. Zamawia pizzę i szklankę soku. Płaci przy ladzie. Kelner mówi dziękuję.
